title: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 22 § 205.14 - Time limitations for proceedings involving custody or visitation
body:
In any proceeding brought pursuant to section
					 467,
					 651 or
					 652 of the
					 Family Court Act to determine temporary or permanent custody or visitation,
					 once a hearing or trial is commenced, it shall proceed to conclusion within 90
					 days.
